The first CC47 press from a lane selects Global without clearing; another positive edge while Global is already selected increments exactly one effect-clear generation; hold and release do not repeat it.

Clear changes no lane phase, address, trigger history, source RNG state, accepted voice record, or transport state relative to a no-clear reference.
All modal frequencies remain positive and below 0.45 times sample rate; all poles remain finite and strictly below one; rapid parameter changes remain finite and bounded.
All 24 source-order models retain exact descriptive names and finite nonzero main and auxiliary output; stochastic interleave isolation remains byte exact.
The frozen experiment produces byte-identical PCM, events, snapshots, controller traces, and metrics at host partitions 1, 16, 64, 128, 257, and 512 frames.
Stopped transport and declared zero cases are exact silence; nominal frozen conditions have zero final saturation and every output remains Q27 bounded.
Repeated Core processing performs no allocation, lock, file I/O, JSON, endpoint, or UI work after construction.
The authenticated local JUCE 8.0.15 source tree configures, compiles, links, and fingerprints Pamplist.app without launch or audio/MIDI endpoint access.
